attackers_goals: The attacker may attempt to extract NTLM hashes for credential access.
description: An unusual number of users has sent NTLM to a target in the last hour. This may be indicative of poisoning and NTLM hash harvesting.
investigative_actions: Check that the destination is not a server. Verify that the destination is not external to the organization.
name: NTLM Hash Harvesting
required_data: Palo Alto Networks Firewall traffic Logs
